proof_body:
by
  constructor
  · have hanti : Antitone (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := fun m n h =>
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by
        have h1 : (m : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast h
        linarith)
    exact hanti.tendsto_alternating_series_of_tendsto_zero tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  · intro h
    have h1 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := h.congr fun n => by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    apply Real.not_summable_one_div_natCast
    rw [← summable_nat_add_iff 1]
    simpa using h1
target_source: (∃ s : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds s)) ∧ ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => |(-1 : ℝ) ^ n * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))|)
